sources.title: Visa on Arrival (VOA) in Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bangladesh Police Special Branch border-visa page was last modified 25 August 2026. It gives named and conditional VOA categories and makes issuance dependent on the entry officer's document review.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors from countries where Bangladesh does not have an Embassy or Mission ... are eligible for Visa on Arrival.

sources.title: Visa on Arrival (VOA) General Instructions
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bangladesh Police Special Branch instructions were last modified 25 August 2026 and distinguish qualifying ordinary visitor VOA from conditional mission, origin, investment and clearance routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Upon payment, you'll receive a receipt ... to get your visa stamped into your passport.

sources.title: Bangladesh Immigration Rules
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Special Branch law page states the generic passport-endorsement rule but does not identify an exhaustive current ordinary-passport nationality exception schedule or settle statutory exceptions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: shall have been endorsed by way of visa for Bangladesh by a Bangladesh diplomatic, consular or passport authority

sources.title: Online Visa Application Portal
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Passports, Government of Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The live DIP service allows online form submission, then expressly requires the printed form, documents and fee at a visa office or Bangladesh mission; it is not electronic visa issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Print the completed form ... Take the printed form ... to the nearest Visa office / Bangladesh Mission.

unresolved.reason: Current Special Branch VOA categories either name a separate country cohort or depend on mission absence, reciprocity, origin, investment/invitation, clearance or other individual facts.
